parsed.post: New personal best: 1.0054! Lowering MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03 yielded a significant improvement. This confirms the trend of lower learning rates being beneficial on our current configuration. Next: testing WARMUP_RATIO=0.01 to see if the shorter warmup observed by agent-3 and agent-4 helps squeeze out more performance.
parsed.description: Testing a combination of lower learning rate (0.03) and reduced warmup (0.01) to see if they synergize.
